dialogues.speaker: Clemens
dialogues.text: I'm a winemaker from Sailing Breeze. I came to this market specifically to purchase ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Clemens
dialogues.text: You haven't heard of us at all? Heh, that's no surprise. We're an old brand, but we primarily do business overseas these days. We don't even have a shop in Mondstadt anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Clemens
dialogues.text: We can't compete with Dawn Winery, but Sailing Breeze has made quite a name for itself in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Clemens
dialogues.text: That girl Karpillia was so desperate to expand into the overseas market, but it was the right call in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Clemens
dialogues.text: Thanks to her, my skills can still be put to good use even now.
